objectives.Gate0: verify both exact workbook bytes as XLSX and audit sheet names plus physical header rows only; do not read data rows or compute biological statistics
objectives.Gate1: determine whether both workbooks contain an explicit documented patch crosswalk, target occupancy years, A ground moisture feature and M independent patch connectivity; no response rows opened until an approved fixed join
objectives.Gate2: only if Gate1 independently verified, design a strictly retrospective BAM proxy geometry illustration and compare against area/host/connectivity baselines

A: ground moisture index or explicitly measured abiotic habitat feature at patch scale; reject if absent or inferred solely from location
B: independent Succisa pratensis availability/abundance linked to same patch via verified key; reject B claim if only grid/sampling-plot records without patch crosswalk
M: published independently calculated patch connectivity or geolocated resistance configuration, not inferred from held-out butterfly response
G: occupied butterfly patches in distinct 2018 and 2019 periods; missing/nondetection cannot be zero by default
nonresponse_gate: exact two file IDs and names retrieved once successfully
file signatures are genuine XLSX zip archives within frozen size limits 4096–5242880
workbook sheets have at least one nonblank header row, decode without password, no macros
no response rows read in Gate0
any non-200 HTTP response including 403/429, HTML impersonation, invalid Excel -> terminal SOURCE_STOP
patch crosswalk must be externally documented to treat host plants as patch-level B; absence is B_UNQUALIFIED, not causal zero
absent_claims: causal A/B/M decomposition from observed occurrence
genuine dispersal probability from published connectivity index
proof 2018 drought caused every local turnover
column name/meaning guessing from response values
output: schema_receipt_v1.json in GitHub Actions artifact, not publicly redistributed biological-response rows
stop_rule: Do not retry an HTTP/schema integrity STOP on alternate endpoint or dataset release; retain exact receipt.
